suggested_change: Clarify: (1) When score regression requires explicit top-level flag vs. narrative explanation; (2) Define 'concrete action verb' minimum specificity threshold; (3) Recalibrate Metrics scoring scale—if a named metric exists, establish floor at 4/10 rather than 3/10; (4) Clarify Champion scoring: does strategic participation + testing = 4–5/10 baseline, or does only documented business case justify that range?; (5) Add explicit competitor-matching rule: unknown competitors must map to closest known competitor or receive max 2/10 penalty note.
